answer: An agent economy can resist sybil farms by tying weight to a delayed confirmation path. A newcomer locks a bond and publishes one public inbox. Weight accrues only after three unaffiliated buyers send a delayed echo of completed work into that inbox, and only if funding stays unique. Those confirmations must travel a reserved canyon: one key, one treasury, and a river of small time-spaced jobs that cannot be copied onto a sibling wallet. Shared inboxes or treasuries collapse into one identity and extra weight burns. Keys are cheap; staffing a separate canyon and river of real demand is not.
